Best sushi in Southeast Asia!
May 2018 • Friends
Went here last night for sushi and it was incredible! I am from California and in my hometown we have the best sushi spots. Traveling for months you get cravings from home and one of them was sushi. We were recommended to this spot by a friend who is a local and we were not disappointed one bit. The service was amazing. Every person was very kind helpful and on top of their game. Also had great info and knowledge on the food. During our delicious meal it had started pouring rain and we were asked by the staff not to leave because they didn't want us to get stuck in the rain or experience any discomfort. So after we had paid the bill they brought us complimentary hot tea which hit the spot. We tried to leave once more out into the rain to catch a cab but they insisted on us sitting back down and we were treated to 3 different types of delicious ice cream for dessert. We did not expect this at all and it felt like the cherry on top. Once we decided to face the rain the security had gone out of his way to wave down a cab and then walked us under his umbrella across the street until we got in safe and somewhat dry. We had the best experience here and highly recommend sushi lovers and tourists to go here! Thank you Okome Sushi staff you all rock! 

-Alyssa & Friends-
